import numpy as np

P = np.array([
    [0.6, 0.3, 0.1],
    [0.4, 0.4, 0.2],
    [0.2, 0.6, 0.2]
])

x0 = np.array([1,0,0])

# evolve for 10 steps
x = x0
for _ in range(10):
    x = x @ P

print("After 10 days:", x)

# steady state via eigenvector method
vals, vecs = np.linalg.eig(P.T)
idx = np.argmin(np.abs(vals - 1))
pi = vecs[:, idx].real
pi = pi / pi.sum()
print("Steady state:", pi)
